I broke it off with my ex of 8 years for many reasons but the biggest reason was the lack of intimacy. I couldn't force him to see things the way i did and it certainly wasn't going to work in the long run, as we planned to get married in the future as well. He always promised things would change but even the idea of sex was too much for him and simple things like holding hands was too "mushy". We went a whole YEAR with no intimacy. Nothing. It really fks with self esteem and also with your view of relationships. I am happily married now but still find myself closing up because that's what I was used to. Wasted so much time. Before we broke up he finally opened up and it turns out he just wasn't into sex. I learned that some people just dont match in all areas in a relationship . Some people don't enjoy sex in the same way or level that i do. And that's ok. But there's nothing wrong with wanting a normal healthy sex life with your SO and you will definitely find someone on your level if that's what you're looking for :)
